title: Singularities in phase separation models: a spectral element approach for the nonlocal Cahn-Hilliard equation
summary: The nonlocal Cahn-Hilliard equation provides a natural extension of the classical model for phase separation by incorporating long-range interactions through a singular convolution kernel. While this formulation admits a rich existence and regularity theory, its numerical approximation remains challenging: discretisation of the nonlocal term leads to dense operators, and the singularity of the kernel requires special treatment in collocation-based schemes.
